Stony Brook SBC Tracker

Log each semester's classes, tag the SBC categories they count for, and see what you still need.

Find classes

Weekly schedule

Sections you have chosen show up here. Overlapping classes are outlined in red.

Schedule builder

Enter 2 to 7 class codes and your limits. It finds combinations of sections with no overlaps and lists the tidiest first. Recitation and lab pairings are not checked, so confirm them in SOLAR.

Four-year roadmap

Drag a class into another term, or use its Move menu. Moving a class to a different term clears its chosen section, since sections belong to one term.

Course bank

Classes you want to take but have not placed in a term yet. Drag one into a term above.

Major requirements

Paste the course codes your major requires, from the bulletin or your degree progress report. This shows what is done, planned and missing.

Back up and move your data

Save everything in this tracker as a file, or load a file you saved earlier. Loading a file replaces what is here now. Your data is saved in this browser only, so use a backup file to move it to another device.
